steelman: Static types eliminate runtime errors in production systems.
strongest_attack: A single counterexample refutes the universal claim: a correctly-typed program can still divide by zero, exhaust memory, or dereference a value the type system proved non-null only under unsound assumptions. The claim is overstated.
reconciliation: Because one counterexample falsifies the claim exactly as stated, the strongest attack wins outright; the thesis would have to retreat to a far weaker hedge to survive.
reason: The strongest attack wins: the central claim is simply overstated and a single counterexample refutes it.
